seo.title: About Modern Cabinets
seo.description: A cabinet shop that measures on site and builds glide-out shelving to the sixteenth. Licensed, bonded and insured, installing across the Phoenix valley since 2009.

sections.heading: The people behind your cabinets.
sections.body: Modern Cabinets is a Phoenix workshop that builds glide-out shelving for the cabinets you already own. The same designers, cabinetmakers and installers you meet on day one are the ones who measure, build and fit the work — no subcontractors, no call center.

sections.label: Our story
sections.note: The company narrative goes here — who started Modern Cabinets, why, and what has stayed the same since 2009. Aim for two or three short paragraphs, ideally with a photo of the shop or the team.

sections.heading: What is on.
sections.intro: Everything here has an end date and terms you can read without a magnifying glass.

items.title: Free in-home measure
items.body: A designer measures every cabinet you want changed and leaves a fixed quote.
items.terms: No purchase necessary. One per household.

items.title: Four shelves or more

items.terms: Per shelf. Applies to standard widths only.

sections.heading: Questions, answered.
sections.intro: If yours is not here, call the shop. Nobody is working from a script.

items.question: Do you have to replace my cabinets?
items.answer: No. The shelves fit inside the cabinet boxes you already have. Your doors, drawer fronts, counters and plumbing all stay where they are.

items.question: Will they fit an older or non-standard cabinet?
items.answer: Usually yes, and that is the point of measuring on site. Older cabinets are rarely square, so each shelf is cut for one specific opening.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Our standard glides are rated to **100 lb** per shelf, which covers stand mixers, stacked cast iron and full cases of tinned goods.

items.question: How long does installation take?
items.answer: Most kitchens are done in a single morning. Larger jobs across several rooms can run to a full day, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.
